baseline: e8a610d + wave-6A feature trees + 6B findings JSONs; this unit's edits are confined to client/src/features/** plus the two stale wave-5 guard test files gates.json explicitly dispositioned to U6R-FIX
repairPolicy: Cause-first only: no spec weakened, no assertion deleted. The two re-baselined scope guards keep their invariant's direction (exact five-tree scope list; privileged-address access confined to the one ADR-010-gated screen, presence-guarded). Every client fix goes to the shape the SERVER actually emits, and the specs that had stubbed never-emitted shapes were corrected to the real ones.

findings.fix: Re-baselined the guard to the wave-6 end-state: it now asserts the feature-route directory list is EXACTLY ['account','booking','community','discovery','moderation'] (sorted), so a sixth out-of-scope tree (payments, GPS, AI listing generation — SRS §1.2) still fails the guard. Test renamed to say what it now checks.
findings.reExecution: TEST_STRICT_HANDLES=1 npx jest tests/coverage/coverage-lane.test.js --runInBand → PASS; full suite 63/1397 exit 0 twice (95.2 s, 97.4 s). No longer reproduces.

findings.cause: Blanket ban on any .addressLine1/.addressLine2/.postalCode dereference in shipped client code — written when no booking-gated screen existed. Wave 6 ships exactly the screen ADR-010 permits (ListingDetailPage renders the exact address only when the server's booking-gated serializer included it).
findings.fix: Narrowed the guard while keeping its ADR-010 direction: privileged address keys may be read ONLY by client/src/features/discovery/ListingDetailPage.jsx, and that file must contain the payload presence-guard (addressLine1 !== undefined); any other module touching a privileged key, or the gated screen losing its guard, still fails. The guard also asserts the gated screen exists so it cannot silently revert.

findings.fix: The 'has started' sentence now renders only for in_progress, or pending WITH a finite parsed start time; a pending booking with an unparseable start gets neutral copy ('Cancellation is currently unavailable for this booking.') — no claim the client cannot verify. Server-side refusal remains the enforcement either way.

Per the lane's suggested repair, one 401 NO_SESSION spec added per community screen: MessagesPage (load path), ReviewPage (submit path, new it.each row), SafetyAlertPage (confirm path) — each asserts the actionable copy renders outside the live region AND is announced assertively. Test stubs that had modeled the never-emitted code were corrected to NO_SESSION (same class of fix as AMV-W6-01: never stub a shape the server does not produce).
findings.reExecution: All three new specs PASS; full client suite 32 files / 344 tests exit 0; backend grep re-confirmed the live codes (auth/middleware.js NO_SESSION; eligibility/middleware.js bare default).

findings.cause: LoginPage matched err.code === 'RATE_LIMITED', but the server's login lockout is code LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED (src/modules/auth/service.js:318, pinned by tests/unit/identity.test.js:565) — the NFR-05 lockout copy was dead code and the spec masked it by stubbing the wrong code.
findings.fix: Throttle detection now goes through errorCopy.isThrottleError(err) — the 429 STATUS family, which no future code rename can silently bypass (the lane's suggested repair). messageForAccountError also names LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED / VERIFICATION_RESEND_RATE_LIMITED explicitly for its generic fallback. LoginPage.test.jsx now stubs the REAL shape: 429 LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED with the server's own message.
findings.reExecution: LoginPage.test.jsx 'NFR-05: renders the 429 lockout HONESTLY...' PASSES against the real code: asserts 'Too many failed sign-in attempts', 'about 5 minutes' (details.retryAfterSeconds 300) and 'the lock lifts by itself'. Full client suite exit 0.

findings.cause: Same class as AMV-W6-01 on the resend throttle: client matched 'RATE_LIMITED', server emits VERIFICATION_RESEND_RATE_LIMITED (src/modules/auth/service.js:174).
findings.fix: Both resend surfaces use isThrottleError + the new shared resendThrottledMessage (copy centralized in errorCopy.js exactly as the lane suggested, removing the duplicated template literal). SignupPage.test.jsx stubs the real code and the server's real message.
findings.reExecution: SignupPage.test.jsx 'renders the resend throttle (429) honestly with its retry horizon' PASSES against VERIFICATION_RESEND_RATE_LIMITED ('about 2 minutes' from retryAfterSeconds 120). Full client suite exit 0.

findings.cause: STATUS_LABELS lacked the 'processing' enum value (db data_request_status; set by src/modules/privacy/repo.js when the worker picks the export up), so that one state rendered — and was announced — as the raw enum word.
findings.fix: Added processing: 'Processing — your copy is being assembled'; the not-ready announcement now speaks the human label (STATUS_LABELS[row.status] || row.status) instead of 'Export status: processing'. The || fallback stays for honesty on any future unknown enum value.
